teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.note: The 49ers are 6-0 and back on top at No. 1, helped by a 23-17 win over the Commanders. The offense (+3.9 points) carries them, and next they visit the Falcons as 4.8-point favorites.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.note: Buffalo slips to No. 2 despite a 33-30 win at Las Vegas, and the defense (-1.2 points) is the reason it feels shaky. The offense at +4.8 points keeps them in the S tier.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.note: Jacksonville moves up to No. 3 even after a 34-31 loss to the Texans. Their 74 percent division odds say the standing is still solid, and the Colts come to town in week 8.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.note: At 2-4 the Rams are still ranked No. 4, which says more about their +4.3 rating than their results. The 18-16 home loss to the Cardinals leaves their playoff odds at 38 percent.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.note: Kansas City is 5-0 after a 22-6 win over the Chargers and climbs to No. 5. The trip to Seattle looks tricky, since the model has them as 1.4-point underdogs.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.note: Detroit used its bye week to drop a spot to No. 6, even though their rating rose 0.2. The Packers visit in week 7, and the Lions are favored by 4.9.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.note: Seattle holds at No. 7 after a 17-14 loss in Denver. Drew Lock starts next, which the model puts 1.8 points below their usual quarterback situation, yet they're still 1.4-point favorites over the Chiefs.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.note: The Bears jump two spots to No. 8 on the back of a 31-23 win at Atlanta. Their rating rose 2.2 points, and the Patriots visit next with Chicago favored by 2.6.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.note: New England has won 3 straight, most recently 26-19 over the Jets, and stays at No. 9. The next test is a trip to Chicago, where the model has them as 2.6-point underdogs.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.note: Minnesota is 5-0 and still falls two spots to No. 10 after a bye week. The model sees a defense at +2.5 points and an offense at -1.8 points.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.note: Green Bay has won 3 straight, the latest a 23-13 win over Dallas, and rises to No. 11. The Lions are next, and the model has the Packers as 4.9-point underdogs.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.note: Houston jumps five spots to No. 12 after beating Jacksonville 34-31 on the road. They're only 2-4, but the Giants are next and Houston is favored by 7.4.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.note: Cincinnati had a bye and drops two spots to No. 13 with no change in its rating. The Bengals visit Baltimore next as a slim 0.3-point favorite.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.note: Denver beat Seattle 17-14 and edges up to No. 14. The point differential of -11 is a flag, though the defense at +1.3 points keeps them afloat.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.note: Carolina climbs three spots to No. 15 after a 25-14 win in Philadelphia. The Panthers are 3-2 with 64 percent division odds, and Tampa Bay comes next.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.note: Indianapolis falls three spots to No. 16 after a 26-20 home loss to the Titans, the last-ranked team. At 2-4, their playoff odds are down to 20 percent.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.note: Atlanta drops three spots to No. 17 after a 31-23 home loss to the Bears. The offense at -1.6 points is the problem, and the 49ers are next.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.note: Pittsburgh won 26-19 at Tampa Bay and moves up to No. 18. At 4-2 they're ahead of where the rating sits, and a trip to the Saints is next.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.note: Dallas falls three spots to No. 19 after a 23-13 loss at Green Bay. The defense at -2.2 points is the biggest hole, and the Eagles are next.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.note: Philadelphia leaps 11 spots to No. 20, even after losing 4 straight. The quarterback situation moved their rating +4.9 points, and Jalen Hurts is expected to start against Dallas.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.note: Washington slips to No. 21 after a 23-17 loss to the 49ers. The record is 1-4-1, but the model likes them 2.1 points more than the betting market does.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.note: Baltimore lost 13-10 in Cleveland and slides to No. 22. Tyler Huntley is expected to start, which puts them 3.7 points below their usual quarterback situation.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.note: The Jets nudge up to No. 23 despite a 26-19 loss to the Patriots. The offense at -2.0 points is the weak spot, but Miami visits next and New York is favored by 5.1.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.note: Arizona rises three spots to No. 24 after an 18-16 win over the Rams. They're 2-4 with a point differential of -52, so the rating of -3.5 is still low.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.note: The Raiders have lost 3 straight, the latest 33-30 to Buffalo, and fall two spots to No. 25. The Rams visit next, and Las Vegas is a 5.7-point underdog.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.note: New Orleans holds at No. 26 after a 34-27 win over the Giants. They're 2-4, and the offense at -1.4 points keeps them down. Pittsburgh is next on a neutral field.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.note: The Giants fall two spots to No. 27 after a 34-27 loss to the Saints. Houston is next, and the model has New York as 7.4-point underdogs.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.note: Tampa Bay's six-spot drop to No. 28 is the biggest this week, following a 26-19 home loss to Pittsburgh. At 1-5, they're 6.9-point underdogs at Carolina.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.note: The Chargers are 0-6 after a 22-6 loss in Kansas City, and playoff odds are 0 percent. The offense at -3.0 points is the main issue, and the Rams are next as a 10.8-point test.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.note: Cleveland is 4-2 but ranked No. 30, after a 13-10 win over the Ravens. The offense at -3.0 points explains the gap, and the Browns visit the Titans as 0.4-point favorites.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.note: Miami is 0-5 after a bye and has lost 5 straight. The offense at -2.4 points is the weak spot, and the Jets are next with Miami a 5.1-point underdog.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.note: Tennessee stays at No. 32 even after a 26-20 win over the Colts on the road. Their rating rose 1.7 points, but -7.2 is still the league's worst. Cleveland visits next.
